tips.text: Bank the Pinions and Quills the rank-ups and build need before turning plumes in; donated plumes are gone.
Take Drifting Grace at Evolution II and Evolved Ascension at Evolution IV; both stay active just from carrying Praedos.
Buy Laetum and Phenmor from Cavalero on the way up; they fill the other two Incarnon slots for Evolution V.
Do Evolution II in an endless mission with dense spawns; it needs six activations in one mission.
Run Void Cascade for Evolution III; it keeps Thrax units coming and drops Thrax Plasm.
Land the Heavy Attack on a Thrax in its killable state; shooting it down does not count.
Players call Praedos worth it almost unanimously because its parkour bonuses work without ever swinging it.
Expect a week or two of a few Zariman runs a day; players already ranking Holdfasts reach Rank 4 on the way.
